q: How does a milk chilling centre near Anand work out electricity per litre?
title: Milk chilling centres: power per litre
short: Multiply the centre's billed kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and divide by litres chilled in the same period. Generator diesel during power cuts is Scope 1 and should be added at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre.
audience: Bulk milk chilling centres in the Anand dairy cluster of Gujarat

p: Gas added when the chiller is serviced is Scope 1 leakage: kg added x the gas's GWP.

example.title: Worked example: one day (illustrative quantities)
example.note: Quantities are illustrative; the factor is the CEA grid average.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
